name: quick-exit
description: Safety banner for sensitive pages (e.g. domestic violence, child safety, whistleblower portals). Clicking the banner opens a benign decoy site in a new tab and replaces the current tab with another safe URL — disabling the back button so the previously viewed sensitive content cannot be re-opened.

heading.title: Heading
heading.description: Main heading shown in the banner.

content.title: Content
content.description: Descriptive text below the heading. Keep it short, scannable, and include emergency contact info where relevant.
content.default: Click anywhere on this banner to exit this page. Call 000 if you're in immediate danger.

exitUrl.title: Exit URL
exitUrl.description: Benign URL opened in a new tab when the banner is clicked. Should be a high-trust, innocuous site (e.g. weather, news).

redirectUrl.title: Redirect URL
redirectUrl.description: URL the current tab is replaced with after the new tab opens. Disables the back button so the sensitive page cannot be reopened.

ariaLabel.title: ARIA label
ariaLabel.description: Accessible label announced by screen readers.
ariaLabel.default: Quick exit - click to leave this page immediately
